messages:
julia (Finance): heads up — nightly job created duplicate invoices in NetSuite. looks like webhook replay after stripe signing secret rotation produced records with null external_source_id and the backfill re-ingested them.

olivia (Revenue Ops): oh no. any examples? we need to pause automation before more dups. :grimacing:

matt (Eng): examples: stripe_inv_01J2XyzA and stripe_inv_01J2Lmno. handler logs show webhook shim returned 200 but payload missing source_id. seems the old shim was returning 200 for unmatched signatures after the hotfix.

keith (Eng): that shim change (2025-11-03 hotfix) was meant to suppress alerts, but now it's masking invalid signature events. it should 401.

sanjay (SRE): deploy-bot: rollback? we can flip the feature flag and pause backfill.
sre-bot: rollback initiated for service/webhook-shim -> stable (rev 2025-10-29).

matt (Eng): log snippet:
```
POST /stripe/webhook 200 (signature: missing)
payload: {"type":"invoice.finalized","data":{"object":{"id":"01J2XyzA"}}}
external_source_id: null
handler: shim_v2-hotfix
```

olivia (Revenue Ops): how many dupes? nightly report shows ~47 flagged.

julia (Finance): confirmed 51 NS invoices with null external_source_id, across 12 customers. small revenue impact but support & AR overhead.

keith (Eng): immediate plan:
1) pause billing-backfill cron
2) detection query: find NS invoices with null external_source_id in window 2025-11-03..2025-11-04
3) tag those rows "tmp_orphan" to prevent re-ingest
4) replay Stripe events after shim fixes and validated idempotency keys.

matt (Eng): paused backfill: `kubectl scale cronjob billing-backfill --replicas=0` -> done.

sanjay (SRE): running detection query now.
sanjay (SRE): result: 51 invoices, 12 customers, earliest 2025-11-03T01:12Z.

olivia (Revenue Ops): can we auto-credit duplicates? enterprise customers need manual sign-off.
julia (Finance): auto-credit small accounts; enterprise assigned to AR for manual review. i'll prepare list.

matt (Eng): patch to shim ready: return 401 on signature mismatch + Sentry capture. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/webhook-shim/pulls/92

keith (Eng): run preflight: replay 10 events to staging to confirm external_source_id present and idempotency keys.
matt (Eng): staging replay ok. merged and rolled 12:14 UTC.
sanjay (SRE): re-enabled processing queue but holding full replay until AR reviews enterprise list.

julia (Finance): did auto-credit for 39 non-enterprise duplicates. enterprise (12) assigned to AR.

olivia (Revenue Ops): updating runbook to include rotate-secret checklist and detection steps.

keith (Eng): follow-ups: CI test for signature rotation, add idempotency check in backfill to skip null external_source_id, metric webhook_event_missing_external_source_id -> alert >5/min.
matt (Eng): ticket INFRA-834 created.

julia (Finance): closing loop — customers notified, AR to resolve enterprise credits by EOD Friday. thanks everyone. :heart:

olivia (Revenue Ops): :thumbsup: nice coordination.
